entries.text: SQL 审核任务增加操作人邮箱字段
entries.textEn: SQL review tasks now record the operator's email

entries.text: 修复 SCM 监控配置中机构 ID 的获取逻辑
entries.textEn: Fixed organisation-ID retrieval in SCM monitor configuration

entries.text: 集成 SQL 审核接口重构为 workspace + template 模式
entries.textEn: Reworked the integration SQL review API around workspace + template

entries.text: 平台集成支持混合文件模式审核，并优化更新时间传递
entries.textEn: Platform integration supports mixed-file review and passes update timestamps more reliably

entries.text: 修正集成异常日志中的不准确描述
entries.textEn: Corrected an inaccurate description in integration error logs

entries.text: 按部署模式调整平台列表查询逻辑
entries.textEn: Platform list queries adjust to the deployment mode

entries.text: 为查询负载文件添加文件头注释，优先从工作空间解析 orgId
entries.textEn: Query-load files gained a header comment and resolve orgId from the workspace first

entries.text: openGauss 与 DWS 改用脚本解析器
entries.textEn: openGauss and DWS now use the script parser

entries.text: 为脚本型数据库构建文件信息元数据
entries.textEn: Build file-information metadata for script-based databases

entries.text: 新增索引兜底清理与持久化逻辑
entries.textEn: Added fallback index clean-up with persistence

entries.text: 修复自定义规则分析时缺失规则名称的问题
entries.textEn: Fixed missing rule names when analysing with custom rules

entries.text: 查询顺序保持改用 LinkedHashMap
entries.textEn: Switched to LinkedHashMap to preserve query order

entries.text: 统一使用审计规则常量替换分析规则常量
entries.textEn: Replaced analysis-rule constants with the audit-rule constants

entries.text: 支持前端传递自定义规则进行 SQL 分析
entries.textEn: The front end can pass custom rules into SQL analysis

entries.text: 分析记录增加规则模板信息，并改进工作负载处理
entries.textEn: Analysis records carry rule-template information, and workload handling improved

entries.text: 过滤非独立类的语法类审核规则；任务中只用 queryadvisor 做规则审核与重写优化；删除 SQLAuditor 的引用
entries.textEn: Syntax-level rules without their own class are filtered out; tasks use queryadvisor for rule review and rewrite optimisation; SQLAuditor references removed

entries.text: 修复默认规则模板加载与工单模板选择逻辑
entries.textEn: Fixed default rule-template loading and ticket-template selection

entries.text: 分页查询最大限制设为 10000
entries.textEn: Paged queries are capped at 10000 rows

entries.text: 移除 RuleTemplateRequestDto 的 @Builder 注解并更新调用
entries.textEn: Removed the @Builder annotation from RuleTemplateRequestDto and updated callers

entries.text: 审计详情返回规则模板名称
entries.textEn: Audit details return the rule-template name

entries.text: 修复构建规则树路径时从错误节点开始的问题
entries.textEn: Fixed the rule-tree path being built from the wrong node

entries.text: 新增对象命名规范规则 NCR011
entries.textEn: Added the object naming convention rule NCR011

entries.text: 移除审计详情接口的权限校验
entries.textEn: Removed the permission check from the audit-details endpoint

entries.text: auth 模块合并进 base 模块并重构权限相关代码
entries.textEn: Merged the auth module into base and reworked permission code

entries.text: 慢查询模板支持按数据库实例筛选
entries.textEn: Slow-query templates can be filtered by database instance

entries.text: 其余内部改动（1 条提交）
